title: 2019年6月 第2套

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: France is facing potentially more than $1 billion in lost revenue this year due to huge declines in tourism.
lines.translation: 法国今年可能面临10亿美元以上的收入损失,

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Safety concerns have been one of the biggest reasons why the country has lost over half a billion in revenue already in the first six months of 2016.
lines.translation: 安全关切一直是该国在2016年前六个月已经失去5亿多收入的最大原因之一。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The terror attacks in Paris last November were called Europe's worst in the past decade.
lines.translation: 去年11月在巴黎发生的恐怖袭击被称为过去十年中欧洲最严重的袭击。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Besides violence, workers' strikes and heavy floods are said to have also been why international tourists have stayed away.
lines.translation: 除了暴力之外,工人罢工和严重水灾据说也成为国际游客不前来的原因。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So far in the Paris region, there's been a 46% decline in Japanese visitors, 35% fewer Russians and 27% fewer Italians.
lines.translation: 到目前为止,在巴黎地区 日本游客减少了46% 俄国人减少了35% 意大利人减少了27%

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: American travelers seem the least affected.
lines.translation: 美国旅行者似乎受影响最小。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Their numbers have only dropped by roughly 5%.
lines.translation: 他们的人数只下降了大约5%。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: According to the French government, the country is the No.
lines.translation: 根据法国政府的说法,法国是“否”国家。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 1 tourist destination in the world, and tourism is extremely important to the French economy.
lines.translation: 1个旅游目的地在世界上,旅游业对法国经济极为重要。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The sector represents roughly 9% of its GDP.
lines.translation: 该部门约占其国内生产总值的9%。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The head of Paris' tourism board said, "It's time to realize that the tourism sector is going through an industrial disaster."
lines.translation: 巴黎旅游局局长说,“现在该是认识到旅游部门正经历工业灾难的时候了。”

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 1. What accounts most for the huge declines in tourism in France?
lines.translation: 第 1 题：法国旅游业大幅下滑最主要的原因是什么？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 2. What do we learn from the report about tourism in France?
lines.translation: 第 2 题：从报告中我们对法国旅游业了解到什么？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: A small plane with two sick US workers arrived safely in Chile late Wednesday after leaving Antarctica in a daring rescue mission from a remote South Pole research station.
lines.translation: 一小架飞机上有两个生病的美国工人在星期三晚期安全抵达智利,

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: After making a stop for a few hours at a British station on the edge of Antarctica, the two workers were flown to the southernmost Chilean city of Punta Arenas.
lines.translation: 在南极洲边缘的一个英国站停留了几个小时后,两名工人被空运到智利最南端城市Punta Arenas。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In a chaotic two days of flying, the rescue team flew 3,000 miles round-trip from the British station Rothera to pick up the workers at the US Amundsen-Scott station at the South Pole.
lines.translation: 在两天的混乱飞行中 救援队从英国罗瑟塔站 绕行3000英里 接着南极美国阿蒙森 -斯科特站的工人

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: "The two patients aboard will be transported to a medical facility that can provide a level of care that is not available at Amundsen-Scott," says a spokesperson.
lines.translation: 一位发言人说,“船上的两名病人将被送往一个医疗设施,提供在Amundsen-Scott没有的护理水平。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Normally planes don't go to the polar post from February to October because of the dangers of flying in the pitch-dark and cold.
lines.translation: 通常2月至10月 飞机不会飞到极地哨所 因为飞行危险 偏僻和寒冷

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: "Antarctica creates a hostile environment," says the operations director for the British Antarctic Survey.
lines.translation: 英国南极勘察局业务主任表示:「反南极活动制造敌对环境」。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: "If you're not careful, it'll come round and bite you."
lines.translation: "如果你不小心,它会来 圆咬你。"

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 3. What was the small plane's mission to Antarctica?
lines.translation: 第 3 题：小型飞机前往南极洲的任务是什么？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 4. What makes flying to Antarctica dangerous from February to October?
lines.translation: 第 4 题：是什么使得二月到十月飞往南极洲变得危险？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: News Report 3 A pilot from Virginia removed his son's loose tooth using a helicopter.
lines.translation: 3号新闻报告 弗吉尼亚的飞行员用直升机 取走了他儿子的松牙齿

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: A pilot from Virginia removed his son's loose tooth using a helicopter.
lines.translation: 弗吉尼亚的飞行员用直升机 取走了他儿子的牙齿

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Rick Rahim, from Virginia, flies helicopters for a living, and when his seven-year-old son's tooth became loose, he did not waste time by tying it to a door handle.
lines.translation: Rick Rahim,来自弗吉尼亚州,用直升机谋生,当他7岁的儿子牙齿松动时,他没有将牙齿绑在门把手上来浪费时间。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Instead, Mr. Rahim tied one end of a string around his son's tooth and the other end to his full-sized commercial helicopter.
lines.translation: 相反,Rahim先生将他儿子牙齿的绳子一端绑在身上,另一端绑在他的全尺寸商用直升机上。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The father of four posted a video clip of his playful venture on Facebook, advising parents to do fun and creative stuff with their kids.
lines.translation: 四人的父亲在脸书上张贴了他的娱乐冒险视频片段,

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The video shows him launching the helicopter into the air and flying just far enough to successfully remove the loose tooth.
lines.translation: 录像显示他将直升机发射到空中 飞得足够远 就能成功摘掉松动的牙齿

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: At the end of the video, Mr. Rahim assures watchers that the circumstances were safe, and that he has 13 years of helicopter flying experience behind him.
lines.translation: 在录像结束时,Rahim先生向观察者保证,情况是安全的,他有13年的直升机飞行经验。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: "You've got to do everything safe in life, and that's what I did today," he said.
lines.translation: 他说"你必须做所有安全的事" 他说"我今天就是这么做的"

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Mr. Rahim later said that although some parents have used remote control helicopters to pull teeth before, he might be the first to use a full-sized aircraft, as he can't find evidence that it has been done before.
lines.translation: Rahim先生后来说,虽然一些父母以前曾使用遥控直升机拉牙,但他可能是首先使用全尺寸飞机的人,因为他找不到证据表明以前曾使用过这种飞机。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 5. How did Rick Rahim remove his son's loose tooth?
lines.translation: 第 5 题：Rick Rahim 是如何拔掉他儿子的松动牙齿的?

lines.translation: 第 7 题：Rick Rahim 建议家长们和孩子做什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Hi, Emma's speaking.
lines.translation: 你好,我是Emma。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Who's this?
lines.translation: 请问你是哪位?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Hi, Emma.
lines.translation: 你好,Emma。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I'm Paul from Hennes Delivery Service.
lines.translation: 我是Hennes快递服务的Paul。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Here is a package for you.
lines.translation: 这里有你的一个包裹。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Are you at home to collect it?
lines.translation: 你在家能收一下吗?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Oh, sorry, Paul.
lines.translation: 哦,不好意思,Paul。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I'm out at the moment.
lines.translation: 我现在不在家。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The package is too big and it needs a signature to confirm you have received it, so I would need to deliver it at a time when you are in.
lines.translation: 包裹太大了,而且需要签名确认你收到了,所以我得在你在家的时候送过去。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Okay, well, I'm out all day today, but I should be in tomorrow morning before I go out for lunch.
lines.translation: 好的,嗯,我今天一整天都不在家,但明天上午我出去吃午饭之前应该在家。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And then I'll be at home again later in the afternoon.
lines.translation: 然后下午晚些时候我会再回家。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Will either of those times be convenient for you?
lines.translation: 这两个时间你方便吗?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They're not, unfortunately, I'm sorry.
lines.translation: 很不幸,他们不是,我很抱歉

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I won't be in the area tomorrow as I have some other deliveries to make on the other side of town.
lines.translation: 我明天不会到这里了 因为我还有别的要送的货要送到镇的另一边去

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I could come the day after if that suits you.
lines.translation: 如果适合的话,我可以在后天来

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Okay.
lines.translation: 好的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Yes, that should be fine.
lines.translation: 行,那应该没问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I have a friend coming around in the afternoon, but I'll be at home.
lines.translation: 我有个朋友下午会过来,但我会在家。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So the day after tomorrow will be great.
lines.translation: 所以后天就很好。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Do I need to pay for the package?
lines.translation: 我需要付包裹的钱吗?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: No, you don't.
lines.translation: 不用,不需要。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It says here that you paid for it when you ordered it online.
lines.translation: 这里显示你在网上订购的时候已经付过了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Oh, yes, I did.
lines.translation: 哦,对,我付过了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I got mixed up.
lines.translation: 我搞混了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So you just need to sign the form to say you've received it.
lines.translation: 所以你只需要在表格上签个字,证明你收到了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Okay, great.
lines.translation: 好的,太好了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: See you the day after tomorrow then.
lines.translation: 那后天见。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Yes, see you then.
lines.translation: 好,到时候见。

lines.translation: 对话二

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Hi Emily.
lines.translation: 嗨,艾米丽。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Do you plan to have a going-away party before you disappear?
lines.translation: 你打算在消失之前 有个远走高飞的派对吗?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It'd be really nice for us to hang out together before you go.
lines.translation: 在你走之前 我们一起出去会很好

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I'm not sure.
lines.translation: 我不确定。 。 。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I'm leaving in just two more days, and I'm going to miss all my friends here and especially this place.
lines.translation: 再过两天我就要走了 我会想念这里所有的朋友 尤其是这个地方

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Why don't you come over?
lines.translation: 你为什么不过来?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I'm feeling rather sad, actually.
lines.translation: 其实我感觉很伤心

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I'm currently sitting alone at a table outside the Black Cat Cafe, listening to the rain and watching people passing by.
lines.translation: 我现在独自坐在黑猫咖啡厅外的桌子上 听雨声 看着人们经过

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I'm sorry.
lines.translation: 对不起

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I can't just now.
lines.translation: 我不能现在。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I need to get this assignment finished by Monday, and I'm way behind.
lines.translation: 我要在星期一完成这项任务 而我却落后了

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Anyhow, cheer up.
lines.translation: 总之 振作点

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You're not leaving for good, and you'll absolutely love Italy.
lines.translation: 你不会永远离开的 你会非常爱意大利的

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Yeah, you're right.
lines.translation: 是啊,你说得对。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But I just feel like I'm not quite ready to go.
lines.translation: 但我就是觉得自己还没完全准备好要走。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And studying in a foreign country seems a bit overwhelming.
lines.translation: 而且在国外学习感觉有点让人不知所措。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Just think of your life in Milan.
lines.translation: 想想你在米兰的生活吧。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In the mornings, you can go down to a small local cafe, soaking up the sun's rays and drinking coffee.
lines.translation: 早上你可以去当地的小咖啡馆,沐浴着阳光喝咖啡。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I envy you.
lines.translation: 我真羡慕你。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You can buy lots of gorgeous Italian clothes.
lines.translation: 你可以买很多漂亮的意大利衣服。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That does sound nice.
lines.translation: 听起来确实不错。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And of course I can keep in touch with everyone through Facebook.
lines.translation: 当然我可以通过Facebook和大家保持联系。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Maybe you can all come visit me.
lines.translation: 也许你们都可以来看我。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Of course we will.
lines.translation: 我们当然会去的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: When is your flight?
lines.translation: 你的航班是什么时候?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: On Saturday, after lunch, at 1:45.
lines.translation: 星期六,午饭后,1点45分。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Okay, I'll try and come to the airport on Saturday to see you off, I'll give you a call that morning no matter what.
lines.translation: 好的,我会尽量星期六去机场给你送行,不管怎样那天早上我都会给你打电话的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Mount Etna is one of the most active volcanoes on Earth.
lines.translation: Etna火山是地球上最活跃的火山之一。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The mountain has been in a state of near continuous eruption for half a million years.
lines.translation: 这座山在近五十万年的时间里几乎处于持续喷发状态。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Exploring the Etna geographical area reveals a history written in fire.
lines.translation: 探索Etna地理区域揭示了一段用火书写的历史。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Before the eruptions, it was covered by forests of pine trees.
lines.translation: 在火山喷发之前,这里被松树林覆盖。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Located in southern Italy, Etna is the highest active volcano in Europe.
lines.translation: Etna位于意大利南部,是欧洲最高的活火山。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: However, its height often changes when volcanic material accumulates during eruptions and subsequently collapses.
lines.translation: 然而,当火山物质在喷发期间堆积并随后坍塌时,它的高度经常发生变化。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Few volcanoes in the world have an eruption history so thoroughly documented by historical records — Etna's eruption history dates back as far as 1500 BC.
lines.translation: 世界上很少有火山的喷发历史像Etna这样被历史记录如此详尽地记载——Etna的喷发历史可以追溯到公元前1500年。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Some 200 eruptions have been recorded down through the centuries, but compared with other volcanoes, most of its eruptions have so far been fairly light in terms of death and destruction.
lines.translation: 几个世纪以来已经记录了大约200次喷发,但与其他火山相比,就死亡和破坏而言,它的大多数喷发迄今为止都相当轻微。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Only about 100 deaths have been attributed to the volcano.
lines.translation: 只有大约100人死亡归因于这座火山。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The mountain hasn't been entirely harmless, however; in 1928 it destroyed the town of Mascali.
lines.translation: 然而,这座山并非完全无害;1928年它摧毁了Mascali镇。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Over the centuries, Etna's lower slopes have been shaped by human hands to take advantage of rich soils for growing grapes, apples and nuts.
lines.translation: 几个世纪以来,Etna的低坡已被人类之手塑造,以利用肥沃的土壤种植葡萄、苹果和坚果。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Local people have also carved out over 200 caves in the soft rock and used them for everything from sacred burial places to food storage.
lines.translation: 当地人还在松软的岩石中开凿了200多个洞穴,并将它们用于从神圣的墓地到食物储存等各种用途。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Large mammals once wandered the volcano's slopes, but today foxes, wild cats, rabbits and mice are more common.
lines.translation: 大型哺乳动物曾经在火山的山坡上游荡,但今天狐狸、野猫、兔子和老鼠更为常见。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Some of those small mammals help to sustain such big birds as golden eagles.
lines.translation: 其中一些小型哺乳动物有助于维持金雕等大型鸟类的生存。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 16. What does the speaker say about Mount Etna?
lines.translation: 第 16 题：说话者关于埃特纳火山说了什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 17. What do we learn about the lower slopes of Mount Etna?
lines.translation: 第 17 题：关于埃特纳火山的低坡我们了解到什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 18. What does the speaker say about big birds like golden eagles at Mount Etna?
lines.translation: 第 18 题：说话者关于埃特纳火山的大型鸟类如金雕说了什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Passage 2.
lines.translation: 通行证2。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: My name is Brendan Leonard and I'm an author.
lines.translation: 我叫布兰登·伦纳德,我是作家

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I'm self-employed, which means I work for myself and I do what I love.
lines.translation: 我是自营职业者,这意味着我为我自己工作 我做我爱做的事

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: We have a popular saying in America which goes, "Do what you love and you'll never work a day in your life." But I'm here to tell you that instead of focusing on doing what we love, I think we should focus on loving what we do.
lines.translation: 在美国,我们有一个流行的谚语说, “做你爱的事,你这辈子永远也不会工作一天。” 但我在这里要告诉你, 而不是专注于做我们爱的事, 我认为我们应该专注于爱我们做的事。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In my line of work, you hear a lot about talent, which is an idea we've mostly invented to give ourselves an excuse to be lazy.
lines.translation: 在我的工作上,你听到很多关于才华的事情, 这是一种我们发明的理念, 大多是为了给自己一个懒惰的借口。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Here's why: If you see someone doing something really well, you would say it's because they're talented.
lines.translation: 这就是为什么:如果你看到有人做的很好, 你会说是因为他们很有才华。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You think they're somehow special.
lines.translation: 你觉得他们很特别?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You discount the tremendous amount of work they've done to get to where they are.
lines.translation: 你低估了他们为了到达那里 所做的大量工作

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Research has shown that talent is nothing without hard work.
lines.translation: 研究表明,没有辛勤的工作,才华就无济于事。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I choose to believe in hard work, but not so much in talent.
lines.translation: 我选择相信勤奋的工作, 但不那么相信才华。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: There are no special people, just people who put in enough hard work until something special happens.
lines.translation: 没有特别的人 只有那些投入足够艰苦工作的人 直到特殊的事情发生

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I can promise you one thing: whatever you choose to do for a career, if you work hard at it, eventually, special things will happen.
lines.translation: 我可以向你保证一件事: 无论你选择做什么 事业, 如果你努力工作, 最终,特殊的事情会发生。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They may not happen as quickly as you'd like them to, and they may turn out to be completely different from the special things you imagined at the beginning, but they will happen.
lines.translation: 它们可能不会像你想的那样快地发生, 并且它们可能与你最初想象的特殊事物完全不同, 但是它们会发生。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 19. What do we learn about the speaker?
lines.translation: 第 19 题：关于说话者我们了解到什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 20. What is the speaker's advice to his audience?
lines.translation: 第 20 题：说话者给听众的建议是什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 21. What does the speaker say about talent?
lines.translation: 第 21 题：说话者关于天赋说了什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Passage 3 A question we often ask others and are also frequently asked by others is what do you normally do after school or work?
lines.translation: 通过3,我们经常问别人,别人也经常问一个问题,即你通常放学后或下班后做什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: A question we often ask others and are also frequently asked by others is "What do you normally do after school or work?" Some commonplace answers are, "Well, I go to the gym." "Um, I just go home and watch TV." "I meet my friends for dinner." or "I just go to bed because it's so late and I'm tired." Unlike any of these typical responses, I'm proud to say that I love to dance salsa after a long and tiring day of work.
lines.translation: 我们经常问别人,别人也经常问一个问题:“你通常放学或下班后做什么?” 一些常见的答案是:“嗯,我去健身房。” “嗯,我回家看电视。” “我和朋友一起吃晚饭。”或者“我因为很晚才睡觉,我累了。” 与这些典型的回答不同,我自豪地说,我工作了很长时间,工作累累,我很喜欢跳萨尔萨舞。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Salsa is a kind of dancing that evolved in the mid-1970s in New York.
lines.translation: 萨尔萨是种舞蹈 于1970年代中期在纽约演化

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: My dancing life began not because I wanted to do it, but because my mother was sick and tired of seeing me running around after school doing nothing.
lines.translation: 我舞蹈生活开始不是因为我想跳舞, 而是因为我母亲厌倦了看到我放学后到处跑,

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So she enrolled me into a ballet course when I was six.
lines.translation: 我六岁的时候 她就把我录取进了芭蕾舞课

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I fell in love with it instantly and continued with ballet dancing for about 10 years.
lines.translation: 我立刻爱上了它 继续跳芭蕾舞了大约10年

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Then I left my native country of New Zealand to start my career as an English teacher, which eventually brought my dancing life to a halt.
lines.translation: 然后,我离开祖国新西兰,开始我作为英语教师的职业生涯,这最终使我的舞蹈生活停顿下来。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It wasn't until I rediscovered salsa in a lovely studio while working in Asia that I renewed my passion for dancing.
lines.translation: 直到我在亚洲工作期间 在一个可爱的演播室里 重新发现萨尔萨

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Since then I have been trying to attend dancing classes twice a week after work.
lines.translation: 从那时起,我每周工作后都尝试上两次舞蹈课。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It's a great way for me to relieve stress and pressure, and dance my way towards feeling energetic and happy again.
lines.translation: 这是一种伟大的方法 来缓解压力和压力 并跳我的方式 来感受活力和快乐 再次。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 22. What does the speaker say about the dance salsa?
lines.translation: 第 22 题：说话者对萨尔萨舞说了什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 23. Why did the speaker's mother enroll her in a ballet course?
lines.translation: 第 23 题：说话者的母亲为什么给她报名参加芭蕾舞课程?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 24. When did the speaker's dancing life come to a halt?
lines.translation: 第 24 题：说话者的舞蹈生涯是什么时候停止的?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 25. In what way has salsa dancing benefited the speaker?
lines.translation: 第 25 题：萨尔萨舞在哪方面使说话者受益?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This is the end of listening comprehension.
lines.translation: 听觉理解的结束
